QUOTE: "The index found four spawn sites, all in `programs/`, and none in `library/`." and the table of mutexes (`mbedtls_threading_key_slot_mutex`, etc.) under "What the locks protect when threading is enabled"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says no thread creation in library/, but it never states that library/ supplies the mutex abstraction (threading.c / mbedtls_threading_mutex_t) for threaded callers. It only lists which locks the library uses internally, not that it provides the abstraction.
